notes: Weight, population loss, and daily mortality cutoffs are derived from Doc Raymond's Farmer Validation Workbook and remain provisional until final sign-off.
Environmental score is the higher of daily temperature range and age-specific humidity deviation; it does not diagnose heat stress or disease.
The 2/3/5 C temperature-range thresholds flag most recorded environmental days and require calibration before operational reliance.
Absolute high/low temperature is not part of the formal score until age-specific Philippine farm bands are approved.
Peer comparison remains visible as context but no longer adds risk points.
